keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Kinnelon Borough, homeowners pay an average of $15,035.2 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.93% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 81.9%, assessed values average ~81.9% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 67.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 22.8%, and Morris County claims 10.0%.
